title: Yurika Online — Four-person RPG Concept
flow: Opening: continuous journey art; logo/loading/explicit START in left negative space, minimum one-second preparation
Lobby: continuous camp with floating formation/navigation/departure in empty ground; resources/gift above; touch → small header speech → management
Party: select slot → role-filter collection → choose/swap companion → validate complete/unique party → save
CharacterManagement: full-height approved art; floating mode switch and selectors in left negative space; floating management/nav in right background
Shop: continuous shop scene; three vertical product rows in empty right shelf space → confirm → update inventory
Clan: continuous four-member background; floating board on empty right wall; pinned membership action and goal footer
Expedition: continuous landscape; floating region tabs and party review in right scenery → departure briefing

illustrationStatus.idleArt: New derived cutouts; requires final production art approval
illustrationStatus.backgrounds: Retained opening/shop/clan/regions; camp replaces empty lobby terrace
illustrationStatus.camp: New master, background, four transparent vignettes and table; approved identities referenced; production approval and rigging pending

animation.prototype: PNG breathing via CSS, staggered per member; not rigged Live2D
animation.unity: Animator or prepared Live2D/Spine rigs; keep interface and hit areas stationary

characters.name: 푸른 모자의 마법사
characters.quote: 이번에는 우리 넷이 함께 가는 거야!
characters.story: 익숙한 푸른 모자 아래, 새로운 여정을 꿈꾸는 작은 마법사. 달숲의 동료들과 함께 더 넓은 세계로 향합니다.
characters.skillText: 모은 마력을 방출해 적에게 마법 피해를 주는 주인공의 기본 기술.
characters.supportText: 세 동료와 함께 파티의 공격 흐름을 이끕니다.

characters.name: 달숲의 수호자
characters.quote: 내 뒤에 있으면 괜찮아. 천천히 가자.
characters.story: 방패를 든 작은 어깨에 동료를 지키겠다는 약속이 담겨 있습니다. 앞길을 먼저 살피며 파티를 든든하게 지켜줍니다.
characters.skillText: 방패를 세워 적의 공격을 받아내는 방어 기술.
characters.supportText: 파티가 어려운 순간을 버틸 수 있도록 보호합니다.

characters.name: 달숲의 위치
characters.quote: 책에 없는 이야기는, 우리 함께 써보자.
characters.story: 책장을 넘기다 고개를 든 달숲의 이야기꾼. 호기심 많은 눈빛과 따뜻한 마법으로 동료들의 여정을 돌봅니다.
characters.skillText: 책에 담긴 주문으로 다친 동료의 생명력을 돌보는 지원 기술.
characters.supportText: 긴 여정에서 파티의 회복과 지속력을 담당합니다.

characters.name: 달숲의 궁수
characters.story: 흐르는 물과 바람에서 길을 읽는 조용한 길잡이. 활시위를 살피는 익숙한 손길이 파티의 다음 발걸음을 준비합니다.
characters.skillText: 한 적에게 집중하는 정밀한 원거리 공격 기술.

implementationNotes: Canvas Scaler: reference 2340×1080, Scale With Screen Size. Reflow in Screen.safeArea rather than stretching a fixed 16:9 UI.
CharacterDefinition, PartyState, CharacterProgress, Inventory and ClanState should be separated
Party draft changes commit only after validation and Save; navigation with unsaved changes must prompt
Prototype uses localStorage and demo economy; real accounts/shop/clan require authoritative backend
No four-character battle implementation is included; existing solo combat must be redesigned behind a party battle interface
Prefer Character IDs over display names; new collection members can extend data without changing slot count
Do not treat demo values or role descriptions as finished combat balancing
Prepare layered PSD/rigging and consistent foot anchors for production character motion

Current camp stations belong to character IDs and their activity props. Party order changes formation data, not the activity pose. New companions need a compatible camp layer/station; do not swap arbitrary seated poses onto incompatible furniture.
Extracted camp characters include their seats/benches as vignette layers. Shared table is separate. Production Live2D needs further character/prop separation and occlusion masks.
Images from AI extraction need explicit registration metadata; they are not exact pixel-aligned exports from a layered PSD.

safeArea.unity: Apply runtime Screen.safeArea to UI anchors. Artwork remains full bleed. Resolve UI and character-region intersections rather than partitioning the screen into illustration/UI rectangles.
safeArea.web: viewport-fit=cover; CSS env(safe-area-inset-*) + interior margins. 100dvh adapts to browser controls.
safeArea.tests: Insets in qa-v2 are synthetic coverage scenarios, not a promise of exact OS/browser safe area values.

campLayers.registrationUnit: normalized camp-stage canvas, 1846×852 aspect ratio; upper-left transform origin; keep all foreground layers on the same canvas

layout.principle: One continuous game scene with floating UI in negative space. Do not add opaque full-width header/footer strips or boxed illustration columns.

controls: small formation shortcut in lower-left ground
permanent four-menu group in lower-right ground
lobby.speech: Small floating header popup, outside all camp silhouettes

management.foreground: Approved source aspect ratio; height 100dvh; offset x = left runtime inset; unchanged image bytes
management.widerBackground: Matched soft ambient copy + scenic extension from same source; horizontal blending only, not stretching the character
management.selectors: Thin floating left-edge column; switch above collection
management.panel: Right background; clamp(256 CSS px,31vw,440 CSS px)

shopClanExpedition.foreground: Source aspect unchanged; offset x = left runtime inset; fit height so even distant companions remain before the sidebar
shopClanExpedition.background: Matched ambient camera fills the landscape viewport; no illustration frame
shopClanExpedition.controls: Right negative space, floating; back/title also in upper negative space
shopClanExpedition.shop: Three product rows with visible price buttons

opening.foreground: Full viewport height; uniform scale; position to keep travellers in right scene
opening.controls: Logo, loading, explicit START in left negative space

layout.protection: Normalized source face/hand/leg regions and camp alpha bounds in qa-v4/occlusion.cjs. Check intersections at peak idle scales after any camera/UI change.

navigation.anchor: Same lower-right runtime SafeArea anchor on every gameplay menu; no route-specific position/size/direction overrides
navigation.width: min(clamp(256 CSS px,31vw,440 CSS px), safe interior width)
navigation.height: 52 CSS px; 48 when landscape browser height <=340
navigation.slots: Four equal fixed slots; active state changes color only
navigation.press: No translation, scaling or selection keyframes; preserve color, touch ring and sound
navigation.lobby: Departure and formation actions sit on empty ground beside navigation, not within its layout flow

verification.productionNote: Browser prototype. Use these region/anchor rules with Screen.safeArea on physical devices. Production panorama can be authored with expanded scenery at the target aspect ratio.
